trigger: U03 and U08 panels each returned a 2-1 majority carrying the dissenting lens's major defect. I16 hard-fails an aggregate verdict differing from the discrete panel majority; I6 forbids a major on a PASS; DISAGREE is reserved for a NO-majority split. No rule covered the collision, so no compliant artifact existed.
lesson: A panel majority of PASS carrying one lens's major defect satisfies neither I16 nor I6, and DISAGREE is unavailable.
how_to_apply: A panel majority of PASS carrying one lens's major defect satisfies neither I16 nor I6, and DISAGREE is unavailable. The sanctioned resolution is a NARROW RE-POLL: re-ask only the lenses that never TESTED the dissenting finding, and only about that finding. If they already examined it and declined, re-polling is vote-shopping and must not be done - adjudicate severity on the informed majority and preserve the dissent verbatim in the panel block and audit_notes. Grading a unit not chargeable is NOT the same as dismissing the defect; carry it as a release-level blocker.
evidence: dag run 2026-07-29_090706_cross-repo-lessons-intake: 9 units, 6 retry iterations, 33 independent lens-verdicts across panels of 3 at depth tier full. Shipped as PR #34 (commits 0fd8dbe, f7c3d92).
